name: gmp-3d-spatial-intelligence-static-vanilla-js
description: Enterprise GIS Workbench, GeoJSON Zones & Deck.gl Analytics built with Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (Zero-Bundler ES Modules) and Google Maps Platform.

scripts.typecheck: node --check app.js && node --check nyc-data.js && node --check server.mjs
scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check nyc-data.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','nyc-data.js','server.mjs'])if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);console.log('Static build verification passed.');})"
